term.title: intrinsic defects

definitions.text: Imperfections connected with surface point defects (zero-dimensional), linear defects (one-dimensional), or square defects (two-dimensional) not including extrinsic chemical units in relation to the chemical formula of the solid.

notes.1: Surface vacancies, anionic vacancies (in n-type semiconductors), cationic vacancies (in p-type semiconductors), interstitial cations, edges, corners and kinks are some examples of intrinsic surface defects.

sources: PAC, 2011, 83, 931. 'Glossary of terms used in photocatalysis and radiation catalysis (IUPAC Recommendations 2011)' on page 958 (https://doi.org/10.1351/PAC-REC-09-09-36)
